canonical_project: Blue Fern Cle Elum data center

history.previous: planned; city moratorium introduced while project may retain development rights
history.current: local process; temporary city data-center moratorium adopted, applicability to Bullfrog Flats development rights unresolved

contradictions: City project files confirm Bullfrog Flats local process and Ordinance 1733 moratorium materials, but no signed Ordinance 1733 or July 31 minutes were found in the public portal during this refresh; adoption is corroborated by KOMO/DCD/Hoodline reporting.

The official June 2026 PMU-2026-001 major-modification application on the Cle Elum project page is for residential marketing/sales facilities, not a data center application; the data center proposal appears in council presentation/media records rather than as a posted land-use application.
why_not_in_baseline: Residential/community developer proposing a small-market Washington data center at Bullfrog Flats; baseline did not include Blue Fern or Cle Elum.
